summary: Maya Flores owns the client relationship for Atlas Harbor, with Iris Tan leading delivery and Elena Voss serving as client sponsor. Rusty Rod is consulting for Atlas Harbor, a logistics company, on an Atlas pilot that creates a shared view of shipment exceptions for their operations team. The pilot’s scope includes CSV import, exception tagging, and a daily summary for dispatch supervisors, but automatic customer emails are outside the pilot scope. Maya Flores advises leading Atlas calls with the approved delivery commitment, then scope, then questions for Elena. Leo Park prefers bullet‑point agendas and explicit follow‑up owners, and he will collect dispatcher training questions. The next Atlas progress call is scheduled for October 21, 2026 at 10 AM Pacific, with agenda items covering the revised delivery date, supervisor training, and sample‑file readiness. A shared checkpoint is set for October 23, 2026. Any approved date changes will be published company‑wide.
